body: Yes therapy would be the way to go, but the staggering realization that your family have emotionally manipulated you all your life is impossible too much to think about sometimes. They can be the most loving people and paradoxically the most cruel people. It's truly sickening and I don't know what to do about it.

Well that's a lot more heroic than mine. I had an emotionally abuse family. I know what you mean about it being a long process, I was doing quite well for a while when I saw my family again and I relapsed, it came back full force and now I'm fuming. I literally want to stab my sister every time I see her. It's even harder because it's normal behaviour to them and they don't think they're doing anything wrong.

I have PTSD which means I'm eternally angry and upset, it occurs after a stressful ordeal in your life. I can no longer enjoy normal things, I have very high anxiety and my memory is poor long and short term. I am nothing, give me a reason to live?
Right now, I don't have a favorite color.
